import csv
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt

INPUT_CSV = "load_01.csv"
OUTPUT_PPTX = "report.pptx"
EXPECTED_COLS = ["case", "load_factor", "cycles"]


def parse_csv(path):
    """Read the CSV and return a list of records with raw strings and parsed numbers."""
    with open(path, newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
        raw = [r for r in csv.reader(f) if any(c.strip() for c in r)]
    if not raw:
        raise ValueError("CSV file is empty: %s" % path)

    header = [h.strip().lower() for h in raw[0]]
    if all(c in header for c in EXPECTED_COLS):
        idx = {c: header.index(c) for c in EXPECTED_COLS}
        body = raw[1:]
        get = lambda r, c: r[idx[c]]
    else:
        # No recognizable header: assume columns are in the expected order.
        body = raw
        get = lambda r, c: r[EXPECTED_COLS.index(c)]

    records = []
    for r in body:
        case_raw = get(r, "case").strip()
        lf_raw = get(r, "load_factor").strip()
        cyc_raw = get(r, "cycles").strip()
        records.append({
            "case": case_raw,
            "load_factor_raw": lf_raw,
            "load_factor": float(lf_raw),
            "cycles": int(float(cyc_raw)),
        })
    return records


def fmt2(x):
    """Round to 2 decimals and trim trailing zeros: 1.70 -> '1.7', 2.35 -> '2.35'."""
    r = round(float(x), 2)
    if r == int(r):
        return str(int(r))
    return f"{r:.2f}".rstrip("0").rstrip(".")


def set_cell_font(cell, bold=False, size=Pt(11)):
    for p in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
        for run in p.runs:
            run.font.bold = bold
            run.font.size = size


def add_bullets(slide, lines, left, top, width, height, size=Pt(18)):
    box = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = box.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        p = tf.paragraphs[0] if i == 0 else tf.add_paragraph()
        run = p.add_run()
        run.text = line
        run.font.size = size
    return box


def main():
    records = parse_csv(INPUT_CSV)

    # ---- Statistics computed from the input data ----
    n = len(records)
    loads = [rec["load_factor"] for rec in records]
    load_min = min(loads)          # computed (not displayed)
    load_max = max(loads)
    load_mean = sum(loads) / n
    total_cycles = sum(rec["cycles"] for rec in records)

    summary_lines = [
        f"N cases = {n}",
        f"load max = {fmt2(load_max)}",
        f"load mean = {fmt2(load_mean)}",
        f"total cycles = {total_cycles}",
    ]

    prs = Presentation()

    # ---- Slide 1: Title ----
    slide1 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[0])
    slide1.shapes.title.text = "Engineering Test Briefing"
    for ph in slide1.placeholders:
        if ph.placeholder_format.idx == 1:
            ph.text = "Load test data review"

    # ---- Slide 2: Data (one table: header + one row per record) ----
    slide2 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[5])
    slide2.shapes.title.text = "Data"
    n_rows = len(records) + 1
    tbl_shape = slide2.shapes.add_table(
        n_rows, 3, Inches(0.6), Inches(1.3), Inches(8.8), Inches(0.25 * n_rows)
    )
    table = tbl_shape.table
    for j, name in enumerate(EXPECTED_COLS):
        cell = table.cell(0, j)
        cell.text = name
        set_cell_font(cell, bold=True)
    for i, rec in enumerate(records, start=1):
        values = [rec["case"], rec["load_factor_raw"], str(rec["cycles"])]
        for j, v in enumerate(values):
            cell = table.cell(i, j)
            cell.text = v
            set_cell_font(cell, bold=False, size=Pt(10))

    # ---- Slide 3: Summary (exact computed numbers) ----
    slide3 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[5])
    slide3.shapes.title.text = "Summary"
    add_bullets(slide3, summary_lines, Inches(0.8), Inches(1.6), Inches(8.4), Inches(3.5))

    # ---- Slide 4: Next steps ----
    slide4 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[5])
    slide4.shapes.t"
